# Exotic

Exotic applies a glassmorphism interface with blurred translucent panels, Source Code Pro monospace typography and contrast tuned for dark mode. Colors are exposed as CSS variables for customization, and the recorded description adds alternating table rows, distinct inline and block code styling, and hover transitions.

![Exotic screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jzcurious/obsidian-theme-exotic-original/HEAD/promo_screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Exotic"
    author: "jzcurious"
    repo:   "jzcurious/obsidian-theme-exotic-original"
    slug:   "exotic"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/exotic"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/jzcurious/obsidian-theme-exotic-original"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jzcurious/obsidian-theme-exotic-original/HEAD/promo_screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply Exotic to give Obsidian a glassmorphism UI with Source Code Pro monospace typography, blurred translucent panels, and dark-optimized contrast. Customize colors via CSS variables and get alternating-row tables, distinct inline/block code styling, and smooth hover transitions."
}
```
